title: Equalizers of the inverse images of sheafified representables
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with objects in universe $u$ and morphisms in universe $v$, with finite limits. Let $J$ be a precoverage satisfying the covering site axioms [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and suppose the inclusion of $v$-set-valued sheaves into presheaves has a left adjoint $\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let $p:\mathbf{Set}_v\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathbf{Set}_v)$ be a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. Then $U\mapsto p^{-1}(h_U^\#)$ preserves equalizers, where $h_U(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(T,U)$. This assertion has the same universe parameters and weak-sheafification hypothesis as lem-trf-site-point-reconstruction-sets; it asserts only its equalizer step.

proof.text: Yoneda preserves an equalizer: evaluated at T, maps into the equalizer of f and g are exactly maps from T whose composites with f and g agree. This bijection is natural in T, so the representable equalizer fork is limiting.

For the associated-sheaf equalizer comparison, represent a section of the equalizer of the sheafified arrows locally and refine until its two images agree on representatives. This gives a local section of the presheaf equalizer. Two representatives agree in this equalizer after refinement if and only if their images in the original presheaf do. These surjectivity and injectivity arguments show that plus preserves the equalizer. Apply plus twice and identify with the supplied sheafification by uniqueness of the adjunction. The unresolved Lean obligation is the universe-sensitive realization of this step: the available Mathlib exactness leaf applies directly only when the value universe contains the site universes.

proof.text: Apply p.inverse to the resulting limiting sheaf fork. Its left-exactness preserves this limit. Every WalkingParallelPair diagram is isomorphic to the diagram of its two arrows, which gives preservation of all limits of this shape.

lean.statement:
theorem sitePoint_representable_preservesEqualizers
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : Precoverage C) (hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings)
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasWeakSheafify J.toGrothendieck (Type v)]
    (p : GeometricMorphism (Type v) (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type v))) :
    PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair
      (yoneda ⋙ presheafToSheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type v) ⋙ p.inverse)
